description: Qwen3-TTS voice cloning: upload a 3-10s reference audio + the text actually spoken in it + the new text to read; outputs the cloned voice reading the new text.

best_for: cloning a specific voice from a short reference audio sample
generating speech in someone's voice from new text
avoid_for: generic TTS without a reference voice (use qwen3_tts)
selection_guidance.agent_hint: Prefer this when the user provides a reference voice sample and wants new text spoken in that voice. Requires --audio (reference voice), -p (new text to speak), and --param 'ref_text'. Similarity drops if ref_text mismatches the reference audio.
